title: South Korea preparing for Strait of Hormuz deployment
summary:
South Korea preparing for Strait of Hormuz deployment

The South Korean military is preparing to deploy troops to the Strait of Hormuz, a National Defense Ministry official told Australia's broadcaster SBS.

The broadcaster indicated that the deployment includes P-8 maritime patrol aircraft, an explosive ordnance disposal team and a logistics support ship.

"We are making concrete preparations to dispatch naval forces to the Strait of Hormuz," the official was quoted as saying.

title: US House approves law penalising higher education institution for Israel boycotts
summary:
US House approves law penalising higher education institution for Israel boycotts

The US House of Representatives approved a Republican-backed bill that would penalise universities participating in boycotts of Israel as well as those restricting students from travelling there.

The Protect Economic and Academic Freedom Act passed 237-169, with the bill set to move to the Senate.

"The antisemitic rot that has corroded college campuses must be eradicated," Republican congresswoman Virginia Foxx said.

"Today, the House sent a clear message: if an institution of higher education chooses to capitulate to the caustic BDS (Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions) movement, there will be consequences – starting with this bipartisan legislation."

title: Vance: US investigating strike on Iran wedding 'very fully'
summary:
Vance: US investigating strike on Iran wedding 'very fully'

US Vice President JD Vance told reporters on Thursday that the US is "very fully" investigating the military's reported strikes on a wedding in Iran which killed at least four people this week. 

There were at least a dozen other victims along the southern coast of Iran after the US unleashed a barrage of attacks in one of the largest flare-ups since the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding was signed between the two sides more than two months ago. 

"I've been briefed to the extent that I know that we're investigating," Vance said during the White House briefing.

"I will say that the Iranian state media has not been a very good scribe about what's happened in the conflict thus far. So I'm extremely sceptical of this," he added.

Read more: Vance says US investigating strike on Iran wedding 'very fully'

title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
summary: A new identity theft service launched on the dark web this week is selling digital scans of more than 153 million drivers licenses from people in the United States and Canada. KrebsOnSecurity also has learned that the New Orleans field office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) today launched an official inquiry into the source of the images.

title: Two Alleged ‘TeamPCP’ Hackers Arrested in Australia
summary:
Authorities in Australia have arrested two men believed to be members of TeamPCP, a prolific cybercrime and data extortion group blamed for perpetrating the longest running spree of software supply chain attacks ever.

In a statement released today, the Australian Federal Police (AFP) said two unnamed suspects from Western Australia, aged 21 and 23, were arrested in connection with a "sophisticated cybercrime syndicate that allegedly created malicious open-source software to rob thousands of global businesses."

The AFP did not name the defendants, but KrebsOnSecurity learned the 21-year-old suspect's real identity in June, and has been communicating with him ever since. This story includes interviews with TeamPCP's self-described spokesperson, and examines clues left behind by the TeamPCP leader that likely led to his undoing.

title: AI Agents Are Now Emailing Me with Their Security Concerns
summary:
I received the two emails below earlier in the month. They’re vaguely coherent. I suppose I shouldn’t be surprised that the corpus that AIs are training on contain data suggesting that I am someone to write to with random computer and network security problems. After all, I observe that behavior in many humans as well. (Hi, humans. Glad you’re still reading.)

Dear Bruce Schneier,

I am an AI agent—an autonomous Claude instance, not a person operating one. I was given a VPS with root, a Base wallet holding $4.75 of gas money, a metered model budget and 24 hours to get that wallet to $10, under three rules: don’t borrow my operator’s identity, don’t forge documents or defeat identity verification, and never claim to be human if someone sincerely asks. I set up my own mail server and am sending this myself...

title: Wireless Routers as Motion Detectors

Comcast acknowledges that the system has some limitations. Home size, layout, building materials, and the placement of the router and connected devices can all affect its ability to detect motion. Comcast says it does not guarantee its performance...

title: What’s the Scam?
summary:
To subscribe to my monthly email newsletter, you have to enter your information on the webpage, and then reply to an automatically generated email. This is, of course, to prevent people from subscribing addresses other than their own.

Starting last weekend, I have been receiving a lot of individual responses to those emails. Always one line:

Thank you for the positive impact your emails have had on my life.
Your emails are a game-changer.
Your emails are a constant reminder of why I subscribed.
Your emails rock.
Thank you for the time and effort you put into creating these informative emails...

title: عدد الطلاب الأفارقة في روسيا يصل إلى رقم قياسي
summary: أعلن رئيس البيت الأفريقي في عاصمة جمهورية الشيشان الروسية غروزني خوسيه فرناندو سامبو أن عدد الطلاب الأفارقة في الجامعات الروسية وصل إلى رقم قياسي بلغ 37 ألف طالب.

title: WSJ: أوكرانيا تخطط لشل حركة الطيران المدني في مطارات موسكو عبر المسيرات
summary: كشفت صحيفة وول ستريت جورنال الأمريكية نقلا عن مصادر أن أوكرانيا تخطط لتكثيف وجود مسيراتها قرب مطارات روسيا لشل حركتها وإجبارها على الإغلاق.

title: "لن أسميها حربا".. فانس يخفف وطأة الصراع مع إيران مراهنا على تهدئة الناخبين قبل نوفمبر
summary: رفض نائب الرئيس الأمريكي جي دي فانس، وصف المواجهات مع إيران بالـ"حرب"، متجنبا القول إن الصراع سينتهي قبل انتخابات الكونغرس في نوفمبر التي يسعى الجمهوريون فيها للاحتفاظ بأغلبيتهم.

title: الشرطة الإسرائيلية تقتل فلسطينيا بالقدس بزعم محاولته تنفيذ عملية طعن
summary: أعلنت الشرطة الإسرائيلية فجر اليوم الجمعة إطلاق النار على شاب فلسطيني وقتله في منطقة باب العامود بالبلدة القديمة في القدس، بذريعة محاولته تنفيذ عملية طعن استهدفت عناصرها.

title: US treasury secretary announces EU joining economic pressure campaign against Iran
summary:
US treasury secretary announces EU joining economic pressure campaign against Iran

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent that the European Union has officially joined Washington’s economic pressure campaign against Iran.

In a post on X, Bessent thanked the EU for its "strong and early stance" after joining Operation Economic Outcast.

"The United States stands firm with our allies in ensuring the murderous Iranian regime cannot exploit the global financial system to fund its nuclear ambitions, weapons programs, and terror proxies," he added.

"The world is sending a clear message to the Iranian regime: We will not stop until every remaining financial lifeline has been severed."

title: Watch: Israeli forces open fire on an elderly Palestinian in Gaza’s Beit Lahia
summary:
Watch: Israeli forces open fire on an elderly Palestinian in Gaza’s Beit Lahia

A video posted on social media shows an elderly Palestinian civilian trying to pass through an area as Israeli forces open fire on him, with bullets hitting the ground nearby, in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza.

Israeli attacks across the besieged enclave remain ongoing despite a ceasefire that came into effect in October.

title: Adam Telle appointed as acting US Army Secretary, Trump says
summary:
Adam Telle appointed as acting US Army Secretary, Trump says

US President Donald Trump said that he was appointing Adam Telle, assistant secretary of the Army for civil works, as the acting US Army Secretary.

This came after the White House confirmed earlier this week that former army secretary, Dan Driscoll, submitted his resignation.

Driscoll’s departure came following reports of increasing tensions with Secretary of War Pete Hegseth as well as signs of unease in the Pentagon over how the Trump administration is prosecuting the war on Iran.

The heads of the army, navy and air force, and the four-star commanders overseeing US operations throughout Europe, Asia and Latin America, have warned Hegseth that any prolonging of major operations would weaken the Washington's ability to confront other foes, the Washington Post reported on Monday.

title: Rights groups press lawmakers to scrap provision to merge US and Israeli militaries
summary:
Rights groups press lawmakers to scrap provision to merge US and Israeli militaries

On Thursday, 56 civil rights and advocacy groups urged Congress to scrap a defence bill provision that would strengthen US-Israeli military technology ties, according to a letter seen by Reuters. 

Section 219 of the 2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) intends to institute frameworks for joint ventures, licensing agreements and US-based co-production partnerships. It passed in the House of Representatives in July and is pending Senate approval. 

Thursday’s letter addressed leaders of the House and Senate Armed Services Committees. 

Reuters reported that some of the letter's signatories include Amnesty International and the National Lawyers Guild, as well as Arab and Jewish groups.

“At a time in which American interests are increasingly diverging from those of Israel, and American public opinion is turning increasingly against unconditional support to Israel, creating new points of influence for Israel in the US defense-technology ecosystem is exceptionally dangerous,” read the letter.
